title: What a Silly Little Sudoku
author: jackisaacbryan
rules:
-
Inspired by Phistomefel's "Chaos Construction Meta Rules Series (3) - Region Sum Rows", which can be found here: https://logic-masters.de/Raetselportal/Raetsel/zeigen.php?id=000W1F
-
NSA: Fill every row, column, and region with the digits one to nine, without repeats.
Arrows: Digits along an arrow sum to the value in the bulb.
Regions: Draw nine regions in the grid, such that each contains all the digits 1-9 only once. Borders between regions divide rows/columns into segments; each segment in a row must have the same total, and segments in different rows may have different totals. The same applies to columns.
-
Sven's CtC App: https://sudokupad.app/4xirqrfef9
-
solutionCode: Digits on the positive diagonal, starting in R9C1 and ending in R1C9
